product_updates.title: Hackers are stealing Claude tokens from subscribers
product_updates.content: Last month, a Claude user noticed his account was consuming tokens even though he wasn't working. Anthropic has since warned users about hackers.

product_updates.title: Cognition hits $48B valuation, signaling investors believe AI coding is far from a winner-take-all market
product_updates.content: Cognition's valuation multiple is higher than Cursor's was before selling to SpaceX.

product_updates.title: Meta debuts its Muse AI agent. Will consumers trust it?
product_updates.content: Meta's new personal AI agent Muse wants access to users' email, calendars, payments, health services, and more — making the company's biggest consumer AI bet yet a major test of whether people still trust Meta with their data.

product_updates.title: OpenAI fought dirty on career-making math problem, says NYU mathematician
product_updates.content: There is a $1 million bounty for the first person providing a solution to the Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness problem.

product_updates.title: Google Cloud races to catch up in the AI deployment wars with Accenture deal
product_updates.content: Google Cloud expands its enterprise AI push with Accenture, betting on forward-deployed engineers to drive adoption and overcome deployment bottlenecks.

product_updates.title: Chrome is now shipping updates every 2 weeks as AI changes the security landscape
product_updates.content: Google is speeding up Chrome’s release schedule to ship security patches and new features faster.

product_updates.title: Mistral raises €3B as sovereign AI becomes big business
product_updates.content: The French AI lab has raised €3 billion at a €21 billion valuation in a Series D round led by Samsung, Scaleup Europe, and PSG Equity.

technical_breakthroughs.title: Why this month's Microsoft patch release is a doozy
technical_breakthroughs.content: Security gnomes are pumping out patches ahead of an expected onslaught of AI-assisted attacks.

technical_breakthroughs.title: AlphaGenome Atlas: A predictive map of every possible DNA letter change in the human genome
technical_breakthroughs.content: AlphaGenome Atlas maps the molecular effects of 9 billion single-letter DNA variants across the human genome.
